# The Bad Software Company

> Boutique systems-engineering advisory firm helping organizations understand and improve software quality, AI-assisted development, Developer Relations, and practical product delivery.

This file points agents to Markdown-friendly mirrors of the primary public pages and blog posts for badsoftware.com. Each mirror includes its canonical HTML source URL.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://badsoftware.com/index.html.md): The Bad Software Company is a boutique systems-engineering advisory firm focused on quality, AI, Developer Relations, and practical product engineering.
- [About](https://badsoftware.com/about.html.md): Learn how The Bad Software Company helps organizations understand why software, AI systems, and engineering organizations fail to meet expectations.
- [Services](https://badsoftware.com/services.html.md): Consulting, training, speaking, TestOpsy quality investigations, and full-stack design and build work.
- [Contact](https://badsoftware.com/contact.html.md): Contact The Bad Software Company about advisory or build work.
- [Blog](https://badsoftware.com/blog/index.html.md): Articles from The Bad Software Company.
